name: probability_weighted_project_value_incremental_vs_base
question_template: A project has three scenarios. Base-case value: {B} USD million. Upside value: base raised by {U} percent. Downside value: base lowered by {D} percent, then less a one-time remediation charge of {C} USD million incurred only in the downside scenario. Probabilities in percent: upside {PU}, downside {PD}, base case the remainder so they sum to 100; the base probability must be strictly positive or the valuation is invalid. Compute the probability-weighted expected value, the base-case probability, and the downside loss versus base as a positive magnitude (base value minus downside value). Report as the final answer the incremental expected value versus base, i.e. expected value minus base value, keeping its sign, in USD million.

slots.description: Base-case probability in percent after assigning the remainder
Probability-weighted expected project value across the three scenarios
Base value minus downside value, reported as positive magnitude

program:
def solve():
    B = Q(P["B"])
    U = Q(P["U"])
    D = Q(P["D"])
    C = Q(P["C"])
    PU = Q(P["PU"])
    PD = Q(P["PD"])
    PB = 100 - PU - PD
    if PB <= 0:
        raise ValueError("base-case probability must be strictly positive")
    v_up = B * (1 + U / 100)
    v_down = B * (1 - D / 100) - C
    ev = (PB * B + PU * v_up + PD * v_down) / 100
    incremental = ev - B
    loss = B - v_down
    return {"final": incremental, "base_probability": PB, "expected_value": ev, "downside_loss": loss}
